name: Icon Mayhem
description: Cute and crazy icon customizations: physics-based hair, accessories, wings, a pet and effects

customization.name: Customization
customization.description: Turns everything off at once (hair, accessories, the pet, effects) in levels, the garage and menus. Your look stays as it is for when you turn it back on

show-in-garage.name: Show in garage
show-in-garage.description: Show hair on the icon preview in the garage

show-in-menus.name: Show in menus
show-in-menus.description: Show your look on your icons on your profile and on the profile button of the main menu

quality.name: Quality
quality.description: Balanced and Low draw fewer locks and particles and simulate less often, for slower phones and computers. Presets keep their values

focus-title.name: Focus
focus-title.description: Nothing covers your view in hard parts: the things floating around the icon fade and come back when it calms down

focus-mode.name: Focus mode
focus-mode.description: Auto: fades at faster speeds and when you click a lot. Always: faded in every level. The hair stays unless you turn on the option below

focus-opacity.name: Faded opacity
focus-opacity.description: How visible the pet, wings and halo stay while focused, 0 hides them. The trail, weather and particles always hide

focus-hair.name: Fade the hair too
focus-hair.description: The hair, the face locks and everything on the face fade as well while focused

modes-title.name: Game modes
modes-title.description: Turn the whole customization (hair, accessories, pet, effects) off in some game modes

mode-ship.name: Ship
mode-ship.description: Customize the cube riding the ship

mode-ufo.name: UFO
mode-ufo.description: Customize the cube riding the UFO

mode-robot.name: Robot
mode-robot.description: Customize the head of the robot

mode-spider.name: Spider
mode-spider.description: Customize the head of the spider

mode-jetpack.name: Jetpack
mode-jetpack.description: Customize the cube riding the jetpack

emotes-title.name: Emotes
emotes-title.description: Keys that show a little speech bubble above your icon while playing

emote-heart.name: Heart emote
emote-heart.description: A heart in a speech bubble above your icon

emote-note.name: Music emote
emote-note.description: A note in a speech bubble above your icon

emote-exclaim.name: "!" emote
emote-exclaim.description: An exclamation mark in a speech bubble above your icon

emote-question.name: "?" emote
emote-question.description: A question mark in a speech bubble above your icon

spin-with-icon.name: Spin with icon
spin-with-icon.description: The hair is attached to the top of the icon and spins with it in jumps. Turn off to keep the hair on top of the head at all times

hair-length.name: Length
hair-length.description: Length of the longest locks in icon units (the cube is about 30)

segments.name: Segments
segments.description: More segments make the hair smoother and softer

lock-width.name: Lock width
lock-width.description: Width of a lock at the root in icon units, it tapers to a point

hair-top-gap.name: Cap gap
hair-top-gap.description: Leaves the top of the head without hair, in degrees, for icons wearing a cap or a hat: the hair comes out from under it on the sides

face-locks.name: Show face locks
face-locks.description: Wavy locks hanging in front of the face, framing it

face-lock-left.name: Left lock
face-lock-left.description: Show the lock on the left side of the face

face-lock-right.name: Right lock
face-lock-right.description: Show the lock on the right side of the face

face-lock-length.name: Face lock length
face-lock-length.description: Length of the face locks in icon units (the cube is about 30)

face-lock-width.name: Face lock width
face-lock-width.description: Width of the face locks at the root in icon units, they taper to a point

face-lock-inset-x.name: Face lock inset X
face-lock-inset-x.description: Moves the locks towards the middle of the face, negative moves them out

face-lock-inset-y.name: Face lock inset Y
face-lock-inset-y.description: Moves the locks down the face, negative moves them up

face-lock-shift-x.name: Face lock shift
face-lock-shift-x.description: Moves both face locks sideways together in icon units, positive towards the front

face-lock-tilt.name: Face lock tilt
face-lock-tilt.description: One face lock higher and the other lower, in icon units. Positive raises the front lock

face-lock-color.name: Face lock color
face-lock-color.description: Same as the hair, the icon colors or the custom color below

bangs.name: Show bangs
bangs.description: Short hair falling over the top of the face

bangs-style.name: Bangs style
bangs-style.description: Straight: a neat fringe. Parted: combed to both sides from a part in the middle, like Frieren. Side swept: all combed to one side, longer there. One side: hair only on one side of the face

bangs-side.name: Bangs side
bangs-side.description: The side Side swept combs to and One side covers

bangs-transition.name: Bangs edge
bangs-transition.description: One side: 0 cuts the hair off sharply in the middle, 1 makes it shorter and shorter towards the bare side

bangs-length.name: Bangs length
bangs-length.description: How far down the face the bangs reach, in icon units

bangs-density.name: Bangs density
bangs-density.description: Number of locks in the bangs

bangs-spread.name: Bangs spread
bangs-spread.description: How far the bangs reach to the sides from the middle, 1 is the whole face width

bangs-arc-size.name: Bangs arc size
bangs-arc-size.description: How much the ends of the bangs drop down, for icons with a round top

bangs-arc-softness.name: Bangs arc softness
bangs-arc-softness.description: 0 keeps the middle flat and rounds only the ends, 1 makes one smooth arc

bangs-inset-x.name: Bangs inset X
bangs-inset-x.description: Moves the bangs right, negative moves them left

bangs-inset-y.name: Bangs inset Y
bangs-inset-y.description: Moves the bangs down the face, negative moves them up

bangs-color.name: Bangs color
bangs-color.description: Same as the hair, the icon colors or the custom color below

clip-count.name: Clips
clip-count.description: Clips pinned on the bangs, or on the face lock, or on the head

clip-side.name: Clip side
clip-side.description: Which side of the face the clips are on

clip-color.name: Clip color
clip-color.description: An icon color or the custom color below

face-title.name: Face
face-title.description: Detailed anime eyes. Needs Quality: High

face.name: Face
face.description: Eyes, or eyes and a mouth, drawn on the icon

face-style.name: Eye style
face-style.description: Onyx: big dark eyes with a red liner flick. Sapphire: blue to violet with streaks and sparkles, also with heart pupils. Crimson: black whites, a red ringed iris and red veins

face-shape.name: Eye shape
face-shape.description: The mood is in the shape. Flirty: the lower lid pushed up by the cheek. Sultry: heavy half lids. Angry: slanted down to the nose. Kind: soft and drooping. Cheerful: round and lifted. Judging: a flat lid over a half eye. Sad: slanted up to the nose. Surprised: wide open

face-x.name: Eye spread
face-x.description: Icon units from the middle of the face to each eye

face-shift-x.name: Eye shift
face-shift-x.description: Moves both eyes sideways together in icon units, positive towards the front

face-tilt.name: Eye tilt
face-tilt.description: Turns the line between the eyes in degrees, the eyes turn with it. Positive raises the front eye

face-y.name: Eye position
face-y.description: Icon units from the middle of the face, up is positive

face-scale-x.name: Eye width
face-scale-x.description: Stretches each eye sideways (not the distance between them)

face-scale-y.name: Eye height
face-scale-y.description: Stretches each eye up and down

ponytail.name: Tails
ponytail.description: A ponytail tied at the back of the head, or twin tails on both sides

ponytail-position.name: Tie position
ponytail-position.description: Where the tails are tied, in degrees from the top of the head: around 90 is the side of the head, more is lower

ponytail-length.name: Tail length
ponytail-length.description: Length of the tails in icon units (the cube is about 30)

ponytail-thickness.name: Tail thickness
ponytail-thickness.description: How thick the tails are at the tie, in icon units

ponytail-color.name: Tail color
ponytail-color.description: Same as the hair, an icon color or the custom color below

tie-color.name: Tie color
tie-color.description: Same as the hair, an icon color or the custom color below

ahoge.name: Ahoge
ahoge.description: Springy strands sticking up from the top of the head

ahoge-length.name: Ahoge length
ahoge-length.description: Length of the ahoge in icon units

ahoge-curl.name: Ahoge curl
ahoge-curl.description: How much the ahoge curls over, 0 sticks straight up

head-bow.name: Bow on the head
head-bow.description: A bow with ribbon tails on the head

bow-position.name: Bow position
bow-position.description: Where the bow sits, in degrees from the top of the head: negative is the front, positive the back

bow-size.name: Bow size
bow-size.description: Size of the bows, also the ones tying the tails

bow-ribbon-length.name: Ribbon length
bow-ribbon-length.description: Length of the ribbon tails hanging from the bows, 0 hides them

bow-color.name: Bow color
bow-color.description: Same as the hair, an icon color or the custom color below

scarf.name: Scarf
scarf.description: A scarf around the bottom of the head with its ends fluttering behind

scarf-height.name: Scarf height
scarf-height.description: How high the scarf sits, in icon units up from the bottom edge

scarf-width.name: Scarf width
scarf-width.description: How thick the scarf is, in icon units

scarf-length.name: Scarf ends
scarf-length.description: Length of the ends in icon units, 0 hides them

scarf-color.name: Scarf color
scarf-color.description: Same as the hair, an icon color or the custom color below

ears.name: Ears
ears.description: Soft ears on top of the head that twitch now and then

ear-spread.name: Ear spread
ear-spread.description: How far apart the ears are, in degrees from the top of the head

ear-twitch.name: Ear twitch
ear-twitch.description: How often the ears twitch, 0 never

ear-color.name: Ear color
ear-color.description: Same as the hair, an icon color or the custom color below

headband.name: Headband
headband.description: A band over the top of the head

headband-inset.name: Headband position
headband-inset.description: How far down from the edge of the head the band sits, in icon units

headband-width.name: Headband width
headband-width.description: How thick the band is, in icon units

headband-color.name: Headband color
headband-color.description: Same as the hair, an icon color or the custom color below

headband-deco.name: Headband decoration
headband-deco.description: A bow or little ears on the band

flowers.name: Flowers
flowers.description: A sakura or daisy in the hair, or a flower crown

flower-position.name: Flower position
flower-position.description: Where the flower sits, in degrees from the top of the head: negative is the front

flower-color.name: Flower color
flower-color.description: Same as the hair, an icon color or the custom color below

halo.name: Halo
halo.description: A glowing ring floating above the head

halo-height.name: Halo height
halo-height.description: How high above the head it floats, in icon units

halo-glow.name: Halo glow
halo-glow.description: A soft glow around the halo

wings.name: Wings
wings.description: Little wings on the sides of the head that flap on jumps

wing-flap.name: Wing flap
wing-flap.description: How strongly they flap on jumps

wing-color.name: Wing color
wing-color.description: Same as the hair, an icon color or the custom color below

cape-title.name: Cape
cape-title.description: Real cloth: it streams behind you, hangs when you stand and shows its lining when it turns over

cape.name: Cape
cape.description: A cape on the back of the head, a short cape, or a flag on a little pole

cape-length.name: Cape length
cape-length.description: How long the cloth is, in icon units

cape-width.name: Cape width
cape-width.description: Length of the edge pinned to the head (the flag: to the pole)

cape-color.name: Cape color
cape-color.description: Same as the hair, an icon color or the custom color below

cape-lining.name: Lining color
cape-lining.description: The other side of the cloth, also the pattern color

cape-pattern.name: Cape pattern
cape-pattern.description: Plain, stripes, little stars or hearts

pet.name: Pet
pet.description: A tiny friend floating behind you

pet-distance.name: Pet distance
pet-distance.description: How far behind it floats, in icon units

pet-color.name: Pet color
pet-color.description: An icon color or the custom color below

pet-moods.name: Pet moods
pet-moods.description: The pet falls asleep with you, cheers on checkpoints and level completes and is sad when you die

pet-behavior.name: Pet behavior
pet-behavior.description: Float behind you, or run on the blocks of the level: it jumps over spikes, catches up and rides on your head in the ship, UFO, wave, swing and jetpack

hat.name: Hat
hat.description: A cute hat on top of the hairstyle

hat-tilt.name: Hat tilt
hat-tilt.description: Degrees the hat leans to the side

hat-inset.name: Hat position
hat-inset.description: How far down onto the head the hat sits, in icon units

hat-color.name: Hat color
hat-color.description: Same as the hair, an icon color or the custom color below

headphones.name: Headphones
headphones.description: Headphones over the head, plain or with little cat ears

headphones-size.name: Headphones size
headphones-size.description: Size of the ear cups and the band

headphones-color.name: Headphones color
headphones-color.description: Same as the hair, an icon color or the custom color below

headphones-light.name: Light color
headphones-light.description: The glowing rings on the ear cups

headphones-beat.name: Glow to the music
headphones-beat.description: The lights glow and the cups bump to the beat of the level music

glasses.name: Glasses
glasses.description: Round glasses, heart or star shaped ones

glasses-x.name: Glasses spread
glasses-x.description: Icon units from the middle of the face to each lens

glasses-y.name: Glasses height
glasses-y.description: Icon units from the middle of the face, up is positive

glasses-tint-opacity.name: Lens opacity
glasses-tint-opacity.description: How strongly the lenses are tinted, 0 is clear glass

earrings.name: Earrings
earrings.description: Earrings on both sides of the head that swing when you move. Pendulum: a long faceted gold drop, like Yor's

earring-length.name: Chain length
earring-length.description: Icon units the charm hangs below the ear

earring-height.name: Earring height
earring-height.description: Icon units from the middle of the head side, up is positive

earring-inset-x.name: Earring inset X
earring-inset-x.description: Moves both earrings towards the middle of the face in icon units, negative moves them out

earring-color.name: Earring color
earring-color.description: Same as the hair, an icon color or the custom color below

bell.name: Cat bell
bell.description: A collar with a little bell that swings when you jump. Hangs from the scarf knot when the scarf is on

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: How strongly the hair keeps its style near the roots, the tips always stay loose

hitbox-multiplier.name: Hitbox multiplier
hitbox-multiplier.description: Size of the invisible head the hair lies on, relative to the icon. Bigger keeps the hair further from the icon, smaller lets it fall closer and hide behind it

damping.name: Damping
damping.description: How quickly the hair stops swinging

hair-friction.name: Friction
hair-friction.description: Internal friction of the hair: settles swinging and whipping without changing how the wind blows it. Higher looks heavier and calmer

calm-jumps.name: Calm jumps
calm-jumps.description: While the icon spins in a jump the hair turns with it as one piece, instead of whipping around and shaking after the landing

wind-multiplier.name: Wind multiplier
wind-multiplier.description: How much the air affects the hair while moving: it trails behind, gets combed back and pressed to the head. 0 makes the hair look like you're standing still

wind-gusts.name: Gusts
wind-gusts.description: How much the wind strength changes over time, 0 is a steady wind

wind-gust-speed.name: Gust speed
wind-gust-speed.description: How quickly the gusts come and go

wind-flutter.name: Flutter
wind-flutter.description: Small random flicks in the wind that make every lock move on its own

breeze.name: Breeze
breeze.description: Wind blowing even when standing still, 1 blows like running

color-source.name: Color
color-source.description: Primary / Secondary use the icon colors, Custom uses the color below

outline.name: Outline
outline.description: Draw an outline like the icon has

outline-color.name: Outline color
outline-color.description: Black like the icon, or soft lines: a dark plum or brown looks like anime line art

hair-shine.name: Hair shine
hair-shine.description: A glossy ring of light across the hair, like in anime

shine-position.name: Shine position
shine-position.description: Where along the locks the shine sits, 0 is the roots

dyed-tips.name: Dyed tips
dyed-tips.description: The locks fade into a second color towards the tips

tips-color.name: Tips color
tips-color.description: An icon color or the custom color below

tips-start.name: Tips start
tips-start.description: Where along the locks the color starts to change

streaks.name: Colored streaks
streaks.description: How many locks get a different color

blush-spread.name: Blush spread
blush-spread.description: How far the cheeks are from the middle of the face, in icon units

blush-height.name: Blush height
blush-height.description: Height of the cheeks from the middle of the face, in icon units

blush-lines.name: Blush lines
blush-lines.description: Little anime lines over the blush

blush-pop.name: Blush on landing
blush-pop.description: The blush gets brighter for a moment after a landing

sticker.name: Sticker
sticker.description: A little sticker on the face

sticker-x.name: Sticker x
sticker-x.description: How far from the middle of the face, in icon units

sticker-y.name: Sticker y
sticker-y.description: Height from the middle of the face, in icon units

sticker-color.name: Sticker color
sticker-color.description: Color of the heart and the star

reactions.name: Reactions
reactions.description: A sweat drop when you die, hearts when you beat a level, sparkles on checkpoints

cute-death.name: Cute death
cute-death.description: On death the hair bursts into petals and hearts

orb-reaction.name: Orbs and pads
orb-reaction.description: The hair flies up with a puff of sparkles when an orb or a pad launches you

orb-kick.name: Orb kick
orb-kick.description: How strongly orbs and pads throw the hair

trail.name: Trail
trail.description: A long ribbon tied at the back of the head, or little hearts, stars or sparkles left behind while moving

trail-length.name: Trail length
trail-length.description: Length of the ribbon in icon units, or how long the hearts and stars stay

trail-color.name: Trail color
trail-color.description: Same as the hair, an icon color or the custom color below

sparkles.name: Hearts and sparkles
sparkles.description: Little hearts or sparkles floating up around the icon

sparkle-rate.name: Amount
sparkle-rate.description: How often they appear, 0 only on landings

sparkle-on-landing.name: Burst on landing
sparkle-on-landing.description: A few of them pop out after every landing

sparkle-size.name: Size
sparkle-size.description: Size of the hearts and sparkles

sparkle-color.name: Color
sparkle-color.description: Same as the hair, an icon color or the custom color below

petals.name: Show weather
petals.description: Petals, snowflakes, leaves or stars falling and swirling around the icon, more while moving

petal-style.name: Weather
petal-style.description: Sakura petals, snowflakes, autumn leaves or little stars

petal-color.name: Color
petal-color.description: Tints the sakura petals and the stars

sleepy.name: Sleepy
sleepy.description: After standing still for a while little "Z"s float up and the ahoge and ears droop
